query:
SELECT i.id AS identity_id,
                   u.id AS user_id,
                   u.firebase_uid,
                   u.status::text AS "status!",
                   i.status::text AS "identity_status!"
            FROM coupon.auth_identities i
            JOIN coupon.users u ON u.id = i.user_id
            WHERE i.provider = 'KAKAO' AND i.provider_subject = $1
            FOR UPDATE OF i
